Name: ✦ Dolphin's Grace
Description: <light_purple>The current itself seems to move out of its way.
- A <blue><bold>Sprint</bold> <reset>burst that never really fades in open water
- A quick <red><bold>Damage</bold> <reset>nip for anything that can't keep up

Notifications.60: <light_purple>Nothing in the reef keeps pace with it now.
